usage_pdf_key_facts: primary files are lh.BN_Atlas.gcs / rh.BN_Atlas.gcs classifiers + BN_Atlas_210_LUT.txt color table
workflow: mris_ca_label -l <subject>/label/<hemi>.cortex.label <subject> <hemi> <subject>/surf/<hemi>.sphere.reg <gcs> <output>.annot  (maps classifier to a subject's sphere.reg)
'We have also mapped the BN_Atlas on fsaverage space, the resulting files are listed in directory fsaverage'
CIFTI conversion via mris_convert --annot -> *.native.label.gii; wb_command -set-structure CORTEX_LEFT/RIGHT
fsaverage + 32k fs_LR meshes both shipped (164k label.gii + 32k_fs_LR label.gii + native subject 001)
gate_reason: Official package ships BN_Atlas annotations already materialized on the standard FreeSurfer fsaverage mesh (fsaverage/label/lh|rh.BN_Atlas.annot = 163842 vertices; fsaverage/164k/*.label.gii = 163842). The package also includes fsaverage/surf/* (white/sphere.reg parse to 163842/327680), matching the DK fsaverage mesh (163842/327680). Per-vertex indexing is the canonical fsaverage indexing; no resampling required for a direct lh->lh / rh->rh vertex overlap with the DK aparc.
vertex_indexing_reason: Both the Brainnetome annotation (fsaverage/label/*.BN_Atlas.annot) and DK annotation (fsaverage/label/*.aparc.annot) are FreeSurfer annotation files on the same canonical fsaverage mesh; the official package provides the fsaverage surfaces themselves (163842/327680) confirming the reference template. 164k label.gii provides an independent 163842-vertex materialization. Direct per-vertex comparison is structurally sound.
topology_reason: BN package fsaverage/surf/lh.white+rh.white parse to 163842 vertices / 327680 faces == DK fsaverage. No face-count mismatch.
sphere_reason: Direct overlap uses the two fsaverage 164k annotations on the same canonical mesh; no sphere.reg resampling is needed, so the lh==rh sphere anomaly is not a blocker for direct overlap. It only matters if 32k/fs_LR resampling were required.

cross_hemisphere_annot_quirk.note: lh.BN_Atlas.annot contains 13,887 vertices carrying right-hemisphere (suffix _R) parcel names (~8.5%); rh annot has none. Overlap stage must handle these vertices explicitly (exclude or map after hemisphere check). Not a gate blocker for common-surface contract.
